Fields directly under runs[mode] describe the raw plan; runs[mode].reviewed the plan after the model review, and the summary_reviewed* blocks pool those. auto_ok / auto_wrong / held_wrong / held_ok count runs by needs_review (false = imported without asking) and had_problem.
